scripts.build: bun run generate:app-config && bun run --filter '*' build
scripts.dev: bun run generate:app-config && bun run --filter app --filter server --parallel dev
scripts.test:agent-sandbox: e2e run --config e2e.unit.config.ts agent-sandbox/tests && E2E_BUN_ONLY=agent-sandbox/tests e2e run --config e2e.unit.config.ts tests/bun-suites.test.ts
scripts.test:live-screen: OPENBOT_LIVE_SCREEN=1 e2e run --config e2e.unit.config.ts agent-computer/tests/live-screen.test.ts agent-computer/tests/browser-close-announcement.test.ts agent-computer/tests/reset-run.test.ts
scripts.test:live-composio: bun -e "if (!process.env.COMPOSIO_API_KEY?.trim()) { console.error('COMPOSIO_API_KEY is empty or unset, so every case in this suite would skip and this command would still exit 0. Run it as COMPOSIO_API_KEY=... bun run test:live-composio.'); process.exit(1) }" && OPENBOT_LIVE_COMPOSIO=1 e2e run --config e2e.unit.config.ts server/tests/composio-live.test.ts
scripts.test:live-codesandbox: bun --env-file=.env -e "if (!process.env.SANDBOX_TOKEN?.trim()) { console.error('SANDBOX_TOKEN is empty or unset. Bring the sandbox up (docker compose up -d agent-sandbox) and set SANDBOX_TOKEN in .env first.'); process.exit(1) }" && bun --env-file=.env scripts/codesandbox-smoke.ts
scripts.test:live-sandbox-isolation: bun --env-file=.env -e "if (!process.env.SANDBOX_TOKEN?.trim()) { console.error('SANDBOX_TOKEN is empty or unset. Bring the sandbox up (docker compose up -d agent-sandbox) and set SANDBOX_TOKEN in .env first.'); process.exit(1) }" && bun --env-file=.env scripts/sandbox-isolation-smoke.ts
scripts.test:live-workshop: bun --env-file=.env -e "if (!process.env.SANDBOX_TOKEN?.trim()) { console.error('SANDBOX_TOKEN is empty or unset. Bring the sandbox up (docker compose up -d agent-sandbox) and set SANDBOX_TOKEN in .env first, and have the server running (see WORKSHOP_SMOKE_SERVER_URL).'); process.exit(1) }" && bun --env-file=.env scripts/workshop-smoke.ts
scripts.test:live-craft-preview: bun -e "const app = process.env.CRAFT_ACCEPTANCE_APP_ORIGIN ?? 'http://localhost:3220'; const api = process.env.CRAFT_ACCEPTANCE_API_ORIGIN ?? 'http://localhost:3221'; const ping = (u: string) => fetch(u).then((r) => r.status).catch(() => 0); const appStatus = await ping(app + '/'); const apiStatus = await ping(api + '/api/craft/sessions'); if (appStatus !== 200 || apiStatus === 0) { console.error(`craft-preview live acceptance prerequisites missing: app ${app} -> ${appStatus} (start: cd app && APP_PORT=3220 SERVER_PORT=3221 bun --bun node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --port 3220 --strictPort), API ${api} -> ${apiStatus === 0 ? 'down' : apiStatus} (start: cd server && bun --env-file=../.env src/index.ts); Casdoor :8000 and the sandbox gateway :4300 are checked by the script's own preflight. See scripts/craft-preview-acceptance.ts header.`); process.exit(1) }" && bun scripts/craft-preview-acceptance.ts
